THE LINE — VALE LOTS 7 TO 12 — TRUE N.

Stone (under the west wing) · Knoll (the glass) · Sundial · High ground (the vault).

All on one bearing. In the margin, in a woman's hand: "He built the house on top of it so nobody else could."
